description: Create a new, empty campaign (always PAUSED, starting shortly after you enable it). Add ad squads with snap_create_adsquad or snap_copy_adsquad. Give catalog_id (objective SALES) for a catalog (Dynamic Product Ads) campaign. Previews unless confirm=true. Two steps: confirm=false returns a preview and an approval_token; to apply, repeat the same arguments with confirm=true and that approval_token. Use first when launching: make the campaign, then snap_create_adsquad, then a creative and snap_create_ad. Everything starts PAUSED.

approval_token.description: The approval_token returned by the preview of this exact request. Required with confirm=true.

catalog_id.description: Makes it a catalog campaign; the catalog must belong to the ad account's organization

confirm.description: false = preview only (nothing sent). true = apply; needs approval_token from the preview.

name.description: Name to give the new item. Shown in Ads Manager.

objective.description: What the campaign is for, for example SALES, WEB_CONVERSION or TRAFFIC (see the tool description).

name: snap_create_campaign
